title: Renew VPN client certificate
steps: Confirm the error text mentions certificate validation or an expired certificate. | Check the certificate expiry date in the user certificate store. | Trigger certificate re-enrolment from the device management console. | Ask the user to restart the VPN client and reconnect. | Verify the tunnel is up and an internal site opens.

title: Re-register MFA device for VPN sign-in
steps: Verify the user's identity using the service desk verification questions. | Check the MFA service status page for a wider outage. | Remove the stale authenticator registration for the user. | Guide the user through registering the authenticator app again. | Have the user connect to VPN and approve the push notification.

title: Reset VPN profile and update client
steps: Collect the VPN client log from the user's device. | Check the client version against the supported version. | Delete the saved VPN profile and upgrade the client if outdated. | Lower the tunnel MTU to 1300 if the user is on a home broadband router. | Monitor the session for 20 minutes to confirm it stays connected.

title: Move user to nearest VPN gateway and enable split tunnelling
steps: Run a speed test with VPN off and on to confirm the slowdown is VPN only. | Check current gateway load on the VPN dashboard. | Assign the user to the nearest regional gateway. | Enable the approved split-tunnel policy for collaboration traffic. | Re-test file share and application response times.

title: Reinstall Wi-Fi profile and machine certificate
steps: Confirm the device is failing 802.1X authentication on the corporate SSID. | Check that the device account is enabled in the directory. | Remove the saved corporate Wi-Fi profile. | Push the Wi-Fi profile and machine certificate again from device management. | Reconnect and confirm an IP address is assigned.

title: Reinstall wireless adapter driver
steps: Check Device Manager for a disabled or missing wireless adapter. | Roll back the most recent driver update if one was installed. | Install the approved wireless driver package for the laptop model. | Restart the device. | Confirm wireless networks are listed and the corporate SSID connects.

title: Access point health check and channel rebalance
steps: Identify the access points serving the reported floor or room. | Check client count, signal strength and error rate on the wireless controller. | Rebalance channels and transmit power for overloaded access points. | Restart a faulty access point outside meeting hours if needed. | Walk-test the area or ask reporters to confirm stable connectivity.

title: Rebuild Outlook profile
steps: Confirm webmail works, to rule out a mailbox or server issue. | Close Outlook and back up any local PST files. | Create a new Outlook profile and set it as default. | Let the mailbox resynchronise. | Send and receive a test email.

title: Release sender from outbound spam block
steps: Read the bounce message and confirm the 550 5.7.1 outbound block. | Check the restricted senders list in the mail security console. | Scan the user's device and review recent sent items for compromise. | Remove the sender from the restricted list. | Send a test email to an external address and confirm delivery.

title: Enable online archive and raise mailbox quota
steps: Check current mailbox size against its quota. | Enable the online archive for the mailbox. | Apply the standard archive policy for items older than one year. | Raise the quota temporarily if the user cannot send. | Confirm the user can send and that archiving has started.

title: Phishing response: quarantine and credential reset
steps: Ask the user to forward the message as an attachment and not click anything further. | Search for and quarantine the same message in all mailboxes. | Block the sender domain and URL in the mail security console. | If a link was clicked or a password entered, reset the password and revoke sessions. | Record the incident for the security team.

title: Verified password reset
steps: Verify the user's identity using the service desk verification questions. | Reset the password in the directory and force a change at next sign-in. | Share the temporary password through the approved channel. | Confirm the user can sign in. | Remind the user to update saved passwords on phone and other devices.

title: Unlock account and clear stale credentials
steps: Verify the user's identity. | Find the lockout source device in the directory lockout log. | Clear saved credentials on that device (mapped drives, phone mail, credential manager). | Unlock the account. | Watch for 30 minutes to confirm the account does not lock again.

title: Grant shared folder access with owner approval
steps: Identify the folder and its data owner. | Request written approval from the data owner. | Add the user to the folder's security group with the approved permission level. | Ask the user to sign out and back in. | Confirm the folder opens and attach the approval to the ticket.

title: Application role assignment with manager approval
steps: Confirm which role or module the user needs. | Request approval from the user's manager and the application owner. | Assign the role in the application's user administration screen. | Ask the user to sign in again. | Confirm the module is visible and attach the approval to the ticket.

title: Power drain and hardware diagnostics
steps: Disconnect the charger and all peripherals. | Hold the power button for 30 seconds to drain residual power. | Reconnect the charger only and power on. | Run the built-in hardware diagnostics if the device starts. | Raise a hardware replacement if diagnostics fail or the device stays dead.

title: BitLocker recovery key retrieval
steps: Verify the user's identity. | Note the recovery key ID shown on the BitLocker screen. | Look up the matching recovery key in the directory. | Read the key to the user and confirm the device unlocks. | Check why recovery was triggered (BIOS or TPM change) and re-seal the key.

title: Dock firmware and display driver refresh
steps: Reseat the dock cable and test the monitor with a direct cable. | Update the docking station firmware. | Update the graphics driver to the approved version. | Power-cycle the dock. | Confirm displays and USB peripherals are detected.

title: Thermal check and battery replacement
steps: Check for processes using high CPU that explain the heat. | Run the battery health report. | Clean vents and apply the latest BIOS and thermal firmware. | Replace the battery if health is below 60 percent. | Confirm temperature and battery runtime are back to normal.

title: Clear application cache and repair installation
steps: Capture the crash message or event log entry. | Close the application and clear its local cache folder. | Run a repair of the installation from the software centre. | Reinstall the latest approved version if repair fails. | Launch the application and confirm it stays open.

title: Clear SSO session and resynchronise identity
steps: Reproduce the sign-in loop in a private browser window. | Clear browser cookies and cached SSO tokens. | Check the user's application account is active and matches the directory email. | Trigger an identity resynchronisation for the user. | Confirm the user lands on the application home page.

title: Assign application licence
steps: Confirm the error states that no licence is assigned. | Check available licences in the licence pool. | Add the user to the application's licence group. | Wait for the licence to synchronise. | Ask the user to sign out and in, then confirm access.

title: Application performance triage
steps: Confirm whether slowness affects one user or many. | Check application server and database response times on the monitoring dashboard. | Review the database connection pool and long-running queries. | Recycle the application pool in a quiet period if connections are exhausted. | Confirm page and report load times are back within the normal range.

title: Controlled application server restart
steps: Confirm the service is down from monitoring and capture the error (for example HTTP 503). | Check active user sessions and running batch jobs on the server. | Notify affected stakeholders and post an outage notice. | Obtain approval from the change manager or on-call lead. | Take a configuration backup or VM snapshot. | Restart the application service first; restart the server only if the service restart fails. | Verify health checks, sign-in and one key transaction. | Rollback: if the service does not recover in 15 minutes, restore the snapshot and escalate to L3.

title: Roll back failed deployment
steps: Confirm the failure started right after the latest release. | Collect error logs and the release identifier. | Notify the release owner and affected stakeholders. | Obtain approval from the change manager. | Redeploy the previous stable build using the deployment pipeline. | Verify health checks and one key transaction. | Rollback of the rollback: if the previous build also fails, restore the last database backup with L3.

title: Identify runaway process and recycle it
steps: Confirm the CPU or memory alert on the monitoring dashboard. | Identify the process consuming resources. | Capture a process dump for the application team. | Recycle that process or application pool; do not restart the whole server. | Watch CPU and memory for 30 minutes.

title: Log cleanup and disk extension
steps: Confirm which volume is full and what is consuming the space. | Compress and archive application logs older than 14 days. | Clear temporary files using the approved cleanup script. | Extend the volume if free space is still under 15 percent. | Confirm the alert has cleared and set up log rotation.

title: Clear print spooler and re-map printer
steps: Check the printer is powered on and online on the print server. | Clear stuck jobs and restart the print spooler service. | Remove and re-add the printer on the user's device. | Reinstall the printer driver if jobs still stall. | Print a test page.

title: Printer maintenance and toner replacement
steps: Ask the user to open the trays and remove jammed paper following the panel instructions. | Run the printer's cleaning cycle. | Replace the toner or drum if prints are faded or streaked. | Raise a vendor visit if the jam repeats. | Print a test page.

title: Escalate to vendor or L3 with diagnostics
steps: Record what was tried and the result of each step. | Collect logs, screenshots and exact error text. | Raise the case with the vendor or L3 team and link it to the ticket. | Update the user with the reference and expected timeline. | Follow up until the vendor or L3 confirms the fix.
